# deed_kind (Data Source)

Reads a built-in or custom Deed kind, including every published schema version and the computed support levels (which Terraform resource types, runtime paths and native providers feed it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "deed_kind" "server" {
  name = "server"
}

output "server_schema" {
  value = jsondecode(data.deed_kind.server.schema)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Kind name, e.g. `server` or `example.com/ups`.

### Read-Only

- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether the kind ships with Deed.
- `color` (String) Color (`#rrggbb`).
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether the kind is deprecated.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `group` (String) Catalog group.
- `icon` (String) Icon (`pack:name`).
- `id` (String) The kind name.
- `identity_keys` (List of List of String) Identity keys (lists of JSON pointers).
- `plural` (String) Plural display name.
- `schema` (String) JSON Schema of the storage version.
- `storage_version` (String) Current storage version, e.g. `v2`.
- `support` (Attributes) What Deed can do for this kind. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--support))
- `title` (String) Singular display name.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Every published schema version, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--support"></a>
### Nested Schema for `support`

Read-Only:

- `modeling` (Boolean) Entities of the kind can be modeled.
- `native` (List of String) Native in-process providers.
- `runtime` (List of String) Runtime ingestion paths.
- `terraform` (List of String) Terraform resource types mapped to the kind by the state importer.


<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `breaking` (Boolean) Whether it was published as breaking.
- `migration` (String) Migration mode of a breaking version.
- `schema` (String) JSON Schema.
- `version` (String) Version, e.g. `v1`.
